```{r}
# Get input and output
source("./pipe.R")
input = pipeline$xeno_clustering$input
output = pipeline$xeno_clustering$output
```

```{r}
xeno <- qs::qread(input$xeno)

```

```{r}
p <- DimPlot(object = xeno, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.1, label = F)
p
```
```{r}
svg(filename = params$data_out_dir %s+% "xeno_clusters.svg")
p
dev.off()

```

```{r}
p <- DimPlot(object = xeno, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.1, label = F,group.by = "treatment")
p
```
```{r}
svg(filename = params$data_out_dir %s+% "xeno_treatment_UMAP.svg")
p
dev.off()

```

```{r}
p <- DimPlot(object = xeno, reduction = "umap", pt.size = 0.1, label = F,group.by = "orig.ident")+ggtitle("")
p
```
